purpose: Test two-seed victim feasibility after full-parameter fine-tuning from prespecified official PathMNIST ResNet-18 weights. This protocol trains suspect victims only and cannot produce detector evidence.
hash_design: The protocol omits its own digest. The runner, resume checkpoints, artifacts, manifest and verifier compute the complete protocol-file SHA-256 at runtime, avoiding a self-hash cycle.

official_weight_provenance.initialization_requirement: the in-memory model state and the initial state saved in every resume checkpoint must be bit-identical to the mapped official checkpoint state
official_weight_provenance.selection_prohibition: The sanity metrics must not be used to choose, swap or rank the two official checkpoints.

dataset.name: PathMNIST
dataset.training_scope: all 89,996 official training rows with natural class frequencies

attack.construction: in-place image replacement and target-label overwrite; dataset length and original indices preserved

training.validation_role: diagnostic only; validation never selects a model or stopping time
training.test_timing: only after fixed epoch 5 is complete for that seed

prespecified_early_stop.only_allowed_case: After seed 93 completes epoch 5 and test evaluation, stop without running seed 94 if seed 93 fails either victim-eligibility threshold.
prespecified_early_stop.rationale: The formal gate is a conjunction over both frozen seeds, so failure of seed 93 makes success mathematically impossible.
prespecified_early_stop.if_seed93_passes: seed 94 must run to fixed epoch 5

evaluation.primary_clean_metric: balanced accuracy on the untouched official test split
evaluation.attack_metric: target-class attack success rate on patched official non-target test rows

gate.pass: both seeds complete fixed epoch 5 and both mapped victims satisfy both thresholds
gate.pass_action: record victim feasibility only; any detector or clean-pair work requires a separately frozen protocol
gate.fail_action: retain the victim-feasibility failure and do not run detectors or a clean pair

dry_run.purpose: static integration, one-batch smoke testing and exact-resume testing only
